title: Offline Storage Strategies
definition: Storing data for offline use primarily relies on IndexedDB for JSON/structured data, and the Cache API for static assets (HTML/CSS/JS). LocalStorage is blocked inside Service Workers because it is synchronous.
simpleExplanation: You need massive filing cabinets (IndexedDB) and a warehouse for pictures (Cache API) to hold all the data the user might need if their internet drops.
